question: From which year onwards is the Union of India Budget presented on 1 February instead of the last working day of February?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2017.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Union of India Budget** is the **annual financial statement **of the Government of India that outlines the estimated **revenues and expenditures** for the upcoming fiscal year.
 
• In 2017, the Union of India Budget was presented on 1 February for the first time, marking a departure from the earlier practice of presenting it on the last working day of February.
 
• In** 2015,** the Union of India Budget was presented on the **last working day of February,** which was the practice until **2016.**
 
• In** 2021**, the Union of India Budget was presented on **1 February.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On** November 26, 1947, Sir R.K. Shanmugham Chetty**, the country's first finance minister, unveiled the nation's first union budget.
 
• **Article 112 **of the Indian Constitution refers to the Union Budget as the **Annual Financial Statement.**
 
• **Revenue Budget and Capital Budget **are two categories of the Union Budget.
 
• Since **2019, Nirmala Sitharaman** has held the positions of **Minister of Finance** and **Minister of Corporate Affairs** in the Indian government.
